authoring_sequence: Apply the complete static-app change to the exact declared baseline.
Keep index.html, app.js, styles.css, and the calculation documentation aligned.
Run source check, preparation, and full certification before guarded integration.
gate_policy_notes: JavaScript syntax, required browser assets, and document wiring are blocking.
There is no package installation or compilation step for this static application.
Engineering correctness and browser rendering require explicit physical review in addition to automated checks.

source_checks.name: JavaScript syntax
source_checks.expectation: The browser application JavaScript parses successfully.

source_checks.name: Static application wiring
argv: from pathlib import Path; h=Path('index.html').read_text(); assert 'app.js' in h and 'styles.css' in h; assert Path('app.js').stat().st_size > 0 and Path('styles.css').stat().st_size > 0
source_checks.expectation: The HTML references the non-empty JavaScript and stylesheet assets.

source_checks.name: Engineering documentation presence
argv: from pathlib import Path; required=['README.md','docs/methodology.md','docs/validation.md']; missing=[p for p in required if not Path(p).is_file() or not Path(p).read_text().strip()]; assert not missing, missing
source_checks.expectation: Methodology and validation documentation remain present and non-empty.

blocker_discovery_checks.name: Complete static contract discovery
argv: from pathlib import Path; h=Path('index.html').read_text(); required=['app.js','styles.css','README.md','docs/methodology.md','docs/validation.md']; missing=[p for p in required if not Path(p).is_file() or not Path(p).read_text().strip()]; assert not missing, missing; assert all(name in h for name in ('app.js','styles.css'))

physical_checks: Open index.html in a supported desktop and mobile browser and exercise all analysis configurations.
Review diagrams, calculation sets, print output, and responsive layout.
Independently verify representative CSA calculations and design assumptions before engineering use.
